content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Stripe offers a comprehensive e-commerce solution for businesses, but its acceptance in 46 countries comes with a catch: the rest of the world is locked out. PayPal, on the other hand, has a more restrictive approach, with account suspensions that can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy cater to creators, but their lack of international presence and inconsistent payment processing leave much to be desired. Paddle takes a more comprehensive approach, but its reliance on third-party integrations creates a ripple effect of uncertainty. Meanwhile, NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, empowering creators to own their infrastructure and sell digital products without compromise.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

While Stripe operates in 46 countries, its absence in the remaining 149 leaves a significant gap for creators in restricted nations. PayPal's suspension policies, meanwhile, can trap creators in limbo, holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy struggle to expand their presence, while Paddle's reliance on third-party integrations creates uncertainty. In contrast, NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) cater to creators in restricted countries, offering a base-layer infrastructure that enables digital sales without relying on sketchy workarounds or vulnerable platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors for digital sellers, and NOWPayments' real-time payment verification and flat 0.5% fee make it an attractive alternative. Meanwhile, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) integrates NOWPayments seamlessly, ensuring a streamlined payment process for creators. In contrast, Stripe's fees can range from 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, while PayPal's fees are subject to change and can be as high as 3.9%. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy charge varying fees, from 3.5% + 30¢ to 10% + 30¢, while Paddle's fees can range from 2.9% + 30¢ to 4.9% + 30¢.
NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer a permanent structural alternative to Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential for digital sellers, and NOWPayments' automatic on-chain crypto payment verification ensures that creators retain full ownership of their sales. Edge Commerce Stack ($197) integrates NOWPayments seamlessly, automating payment processing and delivery, while also configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC for added security. In contrast, Stripe and PayPal require creators to cede control to their platforms, while Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer limited automation and delivery capabilities.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
By choosing Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can sell digital products without relying on sketchy workarounds or vulnerable platforms.
